about: Eder Sturm Eder says its attorneys have served Oregon for more than 30 years, and it answers the fee question with more care than most: the structure varies by the type of case, and injury work is contingent.

158 reviews at 4.9 from one Portland office. It names no attorney on the pages we could reach, although it publishes bios, so this is a limit of what a crawler could read rather than of what the firm publishes.

json_ld_descriptions: Our attorneys are honored to have served the Oregon community for more than 30 years. We set ourselves apart by truly listening to our clients and putting their story at the center of our advocacy. Through hard work, attention to detail, and true compassion for our clients, we are proud to offer the best in injury advocacy in the Pacific Northwest. We take the time to understand your story so you feel supported, seen, and understood.

Ben Eder is one of the best trial lawyers in the Nation, having tried over 200 jury trials. Trial work is not just a job for Ben, is a way of life. He has won numerous trial attorney awards nationally
